purpose: Fleet runtime update policy: how a proven release reaches running daemons on every fleet node, with activation, health proof, and rollback. File placement without activation is not a deployment.
executor_of: infra/runtime-basket.json/bundle_rules (activation, rollback_intent, proofs) — this contract is the executing procedure behind the basket's declared intent; the basket remains the declaring authority.

sequence.description: Release gates pass on the builder at the exact SHA (contracts/release-gates.json). No gate, no stage.
Principal seed resolvable AND every secret the release's daemons need resolves through cynic-secrets. A release that cannot read its secrets is undeployable.
Binaries copied into <state_root>/releases/<tag>/ (atomic temp+rename per file).
Atomic symlink <state_root>/current -> releases/<tag>, then <state_root>/bin/* links. Read-back: readlink(current) == release dir.
Bounded restart of the declared systemd units only (units list in the deploy plan). Never restart an undeclared unit. Restart is per-unit with its own read-back (active state).
Every restarted unit must answer its health probe (HTTP /health or declared equivalent) within the timeout. No health answer = failed update.
On health failure: switch current back to the previous release dir, restart the same units, re-probe health. Rollback is itself read-back proven. Previous release dirs are retained until GC.
Keep the current plus the two previous release dirs; prune older ones. Never prune the rollback target before a newer release is health-proven.

fleet_order.description: Multi-node rollout order, by registry node name (infra/registry.json). One node converges fully (health-proven) before the next starts. Never update two nodes simultaneously.
fleet_order.rationale: cynic-builder is the canary: it proves the release under load with zero fleet impact. cynic-host-proxmox (hypervisor host, internet ingress) updates only after the builder is health-proven on the new release.

prohibitions: No restart without an explicit --apply and a declared unit list.
No switch without read-back of the symlink target.
No health skip: a release that cannot prove health stays staged, never active.
No pruning of the rollback target.
